info.title: Knowledge graph L2-BPMN: BPMN Participant API
info.description: A pool: a role that owns part of the collaboration. The lifecycle BPMN has 8 and declares no laneSet at all, so the pool is the only unit of role assignment present and its @name is the sole link to a persona. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-participant.
